lore.title: THE KETTLE
lore.text: You put the kettle on. The day can start gently.

lore.title: OPEN WINDOW
lore.text: A little fresh air, a little light. Good.

lore.title: WARM CORNER
lore.text: You've found your warm corner. Settle in.

lore.title: SLOW MORNING
lore.text: No hurry. The tea is still warm.

lore.title: GARDEN
lore.text: Small things are growing because you tended them.

lore.title: BREAD RISING
lore.text: Patience is doing its quiet work.

lore.title: LAST CHAPTER
lore.text: Almost at the end of this cozy book.

lore.title: HEARTH
lore.text: Home. You made a warm place out of ordinary days.
